english: Mother is here, desu~…
So this is Mother's hideout!
Yes.\nThe hangar for the mass-produced Mie and Key units\nis nearby, so stay alert.
Reki, IS team, I'm counting on you!
The enemy is already moving.
You can already tell, nyo!?
There's definitely an energy reading.\nAnd she's just flesh and blood — amazing, Reki.
No — it means the enemy\nis already that close.
No time to scout the terrain.\nBeing popular is tough, huh!
Less chatter, more battle prep!\nThe enemy's drawn their last line of defense.\nDon't overdo it — break it down for sure!
The enemy formation is about the same as before.
They might have something up their sleeve.\nDon't let your guard down!
That is…
What's that machine, desu~?
What's that? It's kinda creepy!
Mother's defense functions are active…
Defense functions?
A function to eliminate intruders.
In other words, it's an enemy, nyo!
Yes — destroy all those machines,\nand the defense functions will stop.
Oh, then it's simple!
Just beat 'em and beat 'em and beat 'em!
Just whack 'em, whack 'em, smash 'em!
Eye beams! Beams! More beams, nyo!
I thought so before, but\neveryone's so energetic, desu~…
Really!\nBut now that we're here, I won't lose either!
I won't lose either, desu~!
More mass-produced units!
Wait —\nthose new ones have big energy readings!\nBe careful!
Are they enhanced?
They all look the same — confusing!
There's still more!?
Ugh, this reading…!\nIt's on par with Mie's final form!
So they brought out their trump card!
Two at once is trouble…
No matter who comes,\nI will strike down all who block our path!
We can do it!\nWe have to!
These lazy recolor 'enhanced versions'\nwith their transparent cash-grab scheme\nare never as strong as they look, nyo!!
Who are you even trash-talking, nyu.
Watch your stamina!\nRear units, support efficiently!
It's fine, everyone's strong!\nWe'll definitely win!
An opponent I can go all-out against… ufufu, wonderful, desu~!
What kind of attacks will they use?\nI'm getting a little excited… fufu!
(But what is Mother after…?\nI don't think she plans to overrun the surface\nwith an army of mass-produced units…?)
Fuu… is that all of them…?
Yes, the defense functions are fully stopped.
Uu, there were so many of them…\nBut…!
It's not over yet, right?
Of course not.\nWe haven't done the important part yet.
I'm still full of energy, desu~!
I can still keep going!
Looks like nothing extra's coming out,\nso is it finally time to meet the big boss?
[CLAUDE]! Lead the way!
Yes…!
